_comment: sample_locust_endpoints.json — complete reference for all supported locust_endpoints.json options.

auth._comment_shared: shared: one token fetched at test start, reused by all users. ${data.*} not available.
auth._comment_per_user: per_user: each user fetches their own token in on_start. ${data.*} available.

config._comment_wait: Wait strategy between tasks (flows and flat endpoints). Applies between steps within a flow too.
config._comment_data: How user data rows are assigned across virtual users.
config._comment_tags: Global tag filters — applied only when cohorts are NOT defined. Run only flows/endpoints tagged with include_tags; skip those in exclude_tags.
config._comment_defaults: Merged into every request (endpoints and flow steps) unless overridden per-item.

_comment_cohorts: Cohorts assign virtual users permanently to a feature subset. Each cohort becomes a separate Locust User class. VUs are distributed across cohorts by weight. When cohorts are defined, global include_tags/exclude_tags in config are ignored — each cohort has its own tag filters. If cohorts are omitted, all VUs share a single task pool filtered by config include_tags/exclude_tags.

cohorts.name: FeatureAUsers
cohorts._comment: 30% of VUs — only run flows/endpoints tagged feature-a

cohorts.name: FeatureBUsers
cohorts._comment: 20% of VUs — only run flows/endpoints tagged feature-b

cohorts.name: FeatureCUsers
cohorts._comment: 50% of VUs — only run flows/endpoints tagged feature-c

flows._comment: A flow is a sequence of steps that run in order for a single virtual user iteration. Steps have no tags — they always run as a unit when the flow is selected.
flows._comment_flow_auth: Optional: add an 'auth' block to a flow to fetch a fresh token at the start of every iteration. The flow token overrides the global auth token for all steps in this flow only — useful when different flows need different tokens (e.g. per-account SAT tokens). Supports the same fields as the top-level auth block.
flows.name: FeatureA — Session Lifecycle

steps._comment_delay: delay_ms overrides the config-level wait for this step only.
steps.name: Poll Until Ready

flows.name: FeatureB — Flow with Per-Flow Auth
flows._comment_auth: This flow fetches its own token before every iteration. The token is injected into each step's Authorization header, replacing the global auth token for this flow only.

body.query: query GetPage($input: PageInput) { page(input: $input) { id title } }
query GetCatalog($accountId: String!) { catalog(accountId: $accountId) { id name } }

endpoints._comment: Flat endpoints run as independent tasks. Each is weighted individually.
endpoints.name: Catalog - By Category

body.query: query GetCatalog($filter: String!) { catalog(filter: $filter) { id name } }
query GetCatalog($filter: String!) { catalog(filter: $filter) { id price } }
